alpha_model.formula: eta_i = gamma_0 + gamma_disagreement*z_disagreement_i + gamma_spread*z_spread_i + gamma_abs_r5m*z_abs_r5m_i + gamma_ttc*z_ttc_i; alpha_i = sigmoid(eta_i)

development_economic_gate.chronological_block_rule: sort H2+H3 unique events by event_close_time_utc ascending then event_ticker ascending; split into five contiguous 300-event blocks B0..B4
conditions: base pooled mean net P&L per event including abstentions as zero > 0
+1c adverse-purchase-price stressed pooled mean net P&L per event including abstentions as zero > 0
base mean net P&L per event > 0 in at least 4 of 5 chronological 300-event blocks
base mean net P&L per event > 0 in newest block B4
base H3 mean net P&L per event > 0
minimum entry coverage conditions satisfied
development_economic_gate.evaluation_predictions: selected-lambda rolling-origin score predictions only: Fold1 H2 plus Fold2 H3; no in-sample full-development predictions
development_economic_gate.global_alpha_0_50_economics: frozen 21N-H result is contextual only; do not reopen or retune global-alpha strategy economics as a new selection search

conditions: pooled H2+H3 conditional-alpha event-equal log loss < Kalshi q log loss
pooled H2+H3 conditional-alpha event-equal log loss < Candidate-E log loss
pooled H2+H3 conditional-alpha event-equal log loss < global-alpha-0.50 log loss
pooled H2+H3 conditional-alpha event-equal Brier <= each of Kalshi q, Candidate E, and global-alpha-0.50
conditional-alpha log loss < global-alpha-0.50 log loss separately in H2
conditional-alpha log loss < global-alpha-0.50 log loss separately in H3
median event-level (alpha0.50 log loss - conditional-alpha log loss) > 0 across pooled H2+H3
all fits converge and all scaler/model/prediction/metric values are finite
every alpha satisfies 0 < alpha < 1 and every p_adj remains between q and pE
no source, timing, lineage, evidence-firewall, or contamination violation

downstream_entry_policy.historical_accounting: hold selected side to settlement for quote-screening research only
downstream_entry_policy.within_anchor_choice: largest adjusted_net_edge; exact tie market_ticker ascending then YES before NO

C1_C2.future_role: one-time non-fresh confirmation/falsification of the frozen full-development conditional-alpha model only after complete H-development PASS and separate full-fit freeze
C1_C2.if_confirmation_fails: reject conditional-alpha v1; do not repair on C1+C2

C3.future_role: later one-time conditional-alpha-specific holdout only after C1+C2 confirmation PASS and separate authorization
C3.if_later_test_fails: reject conditional-alpha v1; no C3 repair

features.interpretation: magnitude of Candidate-E disagreement with the contemporaneous Kalshi midpoint
features.name: abs_candidate_market_disagreement

features.interpretation: magnitude of the frozen causal Coinbase-primary five-minute BTC return
features.name: abs_r_5m

historical_probability_lineage.champion_final_future_inference_role: Use Champion-Final for future prospective/live read-only inference after conditional-alpha model development; do not use Champion-Final retroactive in-sample predictions as historical supervisory baselines.
historical_probability_lineage.principle: Historical supervision uses only frozen OOF/OOS predictions from the same Candidate-E specification that were available before each score stage; Champion-Final is not regenerated in-sample on exposed historical outcomes.

C1_C2_economic_gate.chronological_block_rule: sort 1000 C1+C2 events chronologically and split into five contiguous 200-event blocks
conditions: base pooled mean net P&L per event > 0
+1c pooled mean net P&L per event > 0
base mean net P&L per event > 0 in at least 4 of 5 blocks
base mean net P&L per event > 0 in newest block
minimum_total_entries >= 20
pooled C1+C2 conditional-alpha event-equal log loss < Kalshi q, Candidate E, and global-alpha-0.50 on identical rows
pooled C1+C2 conditional-alpha event-equal Brier <= Kalshi q, Candidate E, and global-alpha-0.50 on identical rows
conditional-alpha log loss < global-alpha-0.50 separately in C1 and C2
median event-level (alpha0.50 log loss - conditional-alpha log loss) > 0
all values finite and all bounded-alpha/between-endpoints/lineage invariants pass

C3_economic_gate.chronological_block_rule: sort 500 C3 events chronologically and split into five contiguous 100-event blocks
conditions: base pooled mean net P&L per event > 0
+1c pooled mean net P&L per event > 0
base mean net P&L per event > 0 in at least 4 of 5 blocks
base mean net P&L per event > 0 in newest block
minimum_total_entries >= 20
C3 conditional-alpha event-equal log loss < Kalshi q, Candidate E, and global-alpha-0.50 on identical rows
C3 conditional-alpha event-equal Brier <= Kalshi q, Candidate E, and global-alpha-0.50 on identical rows
median event-level (alpha0.50 log loss - conditional-alpha log loss) > 0
all values finite and all bounded-alpha/between-endpoints/lineage invariants pass

next_checkpoint.purpose: implement and independently validate the frozen conditional-alpha mechanics and outcome-blind row materialization before any fit or outcome scoring

stress_policy.interpretation: sensitivity analysis only; not an empirical fill, latency, depth, queue, partial-fill, or missed-fill estimate
stress_policy.invalid_price_outside_0_1: invalidate entire scenario; do not cap, omit, interpolate, or impute
